findings.title_en: Worker operating angle grinder with bare hands without gloves
Unconfirmed adequacy of eye and face protection during grinding
Grinding sparks ejected without visible protective screen

summary_en: Three findings were recorded: one medium and two low severity. The most urgent is grinding with bare hands without gloves in frame 1. No plant-wide stop is required, but grinding work should not resume until gloves are provided and eye-face protection and spark containment are verified.
